assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single 3 by 3 square sprite atlas for an ancient Chinese Three Kingdoms cultivation skill-tree game UI. Reference image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: emulate its crisp black woodcut engraving, aged ivory paper, restrained vermilion motion strokes and antique book illustrations; do not recreate the UI, words, arrows or frames. Create exactly 9 equally-sized SQUARE cells in a strict 3-column 3-row grid, invisible grid no gutters. Each icon is centered in its cell with 18% blank margin on all sides and nothing crossing a cell boundary. Opaque flat warm ivory paper #f8f0dc in every cell. Top row left to right: (1 power) one upright open palm with a cuff, a few sharp vermilion impact rays; (2 speed) two elegant overlapping hand silhouettes with swift vermilion motion strokes, readable not anatomical confusion; (3 radius) one small hand inside widening concentric vermilion ripples. Middle row left to right: (4 duration) an ancient Chinese water clock, simple and dignified; (5 carry) a fan of three illustrated ancient general portrait cards with blank borders; (6 critical hit) a strong clenched fist with a vermilion starburst. Bottom row left to right: (7 fortune) a cloth pouch with three round Chinese coins with square holes, black and muted gold; (8 equipment) a spear and lamellar cuirass arranged together; (9 troops) a commanding Chinese general bust in front of two small soldier silhouettes. Keep all subjects at equal perceptual scale. Flat premium hand-engraved printed illustration, fine confident black hatch, limited red and subtle ochre, no glossy rendering. NO circles or medallion borders: code will crop to circles. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO labels, NO UI, NO watermark. Output one square image at least 1536x1536.

Elegant thin black/sepia woodcut ink contours, small muted vermilion details, dark indigo roof tiles, dusty jade foliage, restrained warm daylight and soft architectural shadows, nostalgic hand-printed book pigments. Detailed but lower-contrast ground so foreground portrait cards will be most readable. Quiet broad worn stone routes exit at the midpoint of all four edges so adjacent districts can connect; edge exits must NOT be blocked. Ground has gentle irregular pavers, grass seams, a few rubbed circular marks, subtle texture without repetitive swirls. Crisp near-view detail, not a blurry miniaturized full map. No enclosing outer city wall, no hard border, no rectangular region outline, no grid, no labels, no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no cards, no people or units, no coins or treasure objects.
